products.name: Haier 11 kg top-load washing machine with in-built heater
products.summary: Lift the toughened-glass lid to see the pillow drum, the Magic filter and the detergent box, read the console's controls, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: Body only, 104 cm tall at the console; with the lid open it is about 143 cm
specs: In-built heater, Ultra Fresh Air, Quick Wash, Mix Load, memory back-up
Oceanus Wave drum, stainless steel tub
4 years comprehensive, 10 years on the motor

hotspots.title: Advanced in-built heater
hotspots.text: Haier's advanced butterfly-shaped in-built heater delivers powerful cleaning performance and effective germ elimination.

hotspots.title: Softfall Technology
hotspots.text: Softfall Technology ensures gentle and safe lid closure, preventing accidental slamming and minimizing noise.

hotspots.title: Oceanus Wave Drum
hotspots.text: The Oceanus Wave Drum offers gentle yet thorough washing, mimicking the natural motion of ocean waves to protect your clothes.

hotspots.title: 2X Magic Filter
hotspots.text: It efficiently captures lint and debris twice as effectively, ensuring cleaner laundry and improved washing machine performance.
